contentBlocks.text: ਹਰ ਤਿਉਹਾਰ ਵਿੱਚ ਖਾਣਾ ਬਹੁਤ ਜ਼ਰੂਰੀ ਹੁੰਦਾ ਹੈ। (Food is very important at every festival.) Today, real vocabulary for describing food.

New words: ਦਾਲ (daal, lentils), ਚੌਲ (chaul, rice), ਸਬਜ਼ੀ (sabzi, vegetable dish), ਮਿਠਾਈ (mithai, sweets), and ਸੁਆਦੀ (suaadi, delicious). These are real, common foods served at festivals and in Langar. Write 2-3 sentences describing a meal you've eaten at a festival or family gathering, using at least two of today's new words.
You now have real vocabulary for describing festival food. Tomorrow you'll combine everything from this week into one complete formal letter.

objectives: Learn 5 new vocabulary words for describing food: ਦਾਲ, ਚੌਲ, ਸਬਜ਼ੀ, ਮਿਠਾਈ, ਸੁਆਦੀ
Write 2-3 sentences describing a real festival or family meal
teacherGuide.facilitationScript:
1. Review yesterday's festival vocabulary.
2. Introduce today's 5 new food words, connecting to real dishes the child may know.
3. Have the child draft 2-3 sentences describing a real meal.
4. Complete the worksheet.
5. Preview tomorrow's topic: combining everything into one complete letter.
differentiationTips: Struggling: allow the child to just name 2-3 foods they know rather than writing full descriptive sentences yet
Ready for more: ask them to describe HOW a dish tasted or smelled, not just name it
All Gurmukhi words used in this lesson were validated against gurmukhifix's Lexicon before writing
teacherGuide.answerKey: 1. ਦਾਲ = lentils. 2. ਚੌਲ = rice. 3. ਸਬਜ਼ੀ = vegetable dish. 4. ਮਿਠਾਈ = sweets. 5. ਸੁਆਦੀ = delicious.
teacherGuide.standardsRationale: Builds the cultural/cuisine vocabulary named in the course's 'cultural units — cuisine' description, completing the vocabulary needed for the week's culminating letter.

generationData.instructions: Write the English meaning of each Gurmukhi word.
